outcome: Breastfeeding initiation within the first 48 hours after childbirth
cohort: 671 mothers of infants aged up to 24 months
finding: Caesarean section, preterm birth, and low birth weight were independently associated with lower breastfeeding initiation rates within the first 48 hours after childbirth.
mod_finding: Women who gave birth by caesarean section had a lower likelihood of initiating breastfeeding within the first 48 hours.
